selected_branches.branch: Parking alongside or opposite a highway excavation.

law_text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.

Parking alongside or opposite the excavation, with physical circumstances bearing on whether it would obstruct traffic.
